blurb: Myrtle Beach Family Golf attractions are truly affordable entertainment venues and are considered to be the Best of Myrtle Beach! With four themed miniature golf courses located throughout Myrtle Beach, you’ll experience an excursion from an island marina, an adventurous journey into the world of 10-million-year-old dinosaurs, a jungle safari adventure and a trip into Never-Never Land.
